children: Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas said on X that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved 3x long ETPs for Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, crude oil, and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933. According to Odaily, the approval was made under the Securities Act of 1933.

title: SEC Approves 3X Long Bitcoin, Ethereum, Gold, Silver, Oil, and Natural Gas ETPs Under 1933 Securities Act
